question: Does the current fused physical atomic membership fixture need a generic observed-read facade before any bounded source claim, or is its exact current task-selection input already structurally bound to the held read snapshot?
source_observations: child_node opens the exact DB in SQLite read-only mode and begins an explicit read transaction via open_ro_snapshot.
open_ro_snapshot materializes epoch, generation, tasks, scopes and leases from that same open read transaction and hashes those covered S1 fields into state_digest.
child_node reads its active deterministic membership from the same SQLite connection while that read transaction remains open.
the task-selection helper _choose_task consumes only snapshot['tasks']; it performs no second DB/file/network read and deterministically selects from the materialized snapshot object.
the packet declares generation/epoch/state_digest from that same snapshot object and carries the selected task_id in payload.
the barrier ready record binds the same snapshot identity and membership id while the transaction remains open; parent procfs checks the exact S1 DB is still attached O_RDONLY at the barrier.
concurrent_probe launches the exact script path supplied by the parent with fixed child arguments and checks all children share the exact snapshot identity before release.
the current fixture has no model call, tokenizer input, external retrieval, tool result, file read, network input or other cognition-relevant channel beyond the covered deterministic fixture inputs.

bounded_conclusion.claim: For the exact f30bf2c test-only fixture, the task-selection semantic input is structurally derived from the same held read transaction whose covered tasks/scopes/leases/epoch/generation are included in state_digest. A separate generic read facade is therefore not required merely to support the narrow source claim that this fixture's task selection came from its held S1 snapshot.
not_proved: actual model-visible prompt/token bytes consumed by Qwen3.5
loader/checkpoint bytes consumed by a model runtime
generic hidden/unobserved read exclusion outside this exact child path
J-Space hidden-state input identity or causal use

bypass_discriminator_result.reason: A stale task read cannot be introduced through the audited child_node without changing the exact source/control flow because _choose_task only receives the snapshot materialized from the held transaction. But future model/retrieval/tool paths introduce additional inputs and must bind their actual delivered/consumed identities independently.
bypass_discriminator_result.important_limit: Source control-flow inspection is not runtime execution evidence. It narrows what a future negative must target; it does not mint physical GRID10 runtime credit.

design_decision.decision: Do not insert a generic observed-read facade into the current deterministic no-model fixture solely to duplicate its already source-bound task snapshot. Preserve the S-Bus-derived observed-read method as the stronger future gate for real model/retrieval/tool inputs.
design_decision.required_future_chain: typed admitted task/evidence -> exact rendered model-visible input bytes/tokens -> exact tokenizer/template identity -> exact checkpoint/runtime/loader consumed identity -> model output digest -> NODE_RESULT semantic body -> deterministic membership/process/snapshot authority envelope -> atomic cohort admission

checkpoint_link.current_fact: The gate explicitly keeps consumed_identity_match=UNPROVEN_BY_LOADER_PROBE_V1 and checkpoint selection unresolved; observed loading from a pinned local snapshot path is not consumed-byte attestation.
checkpoint_link.implication: After the deterministic GRID10 source chain, checkpoint/model-visible consumed identity is now a higher-information Trigger-2 gate than adding generic read instrumentation to the no-model fixture.

training_eval_reinjection.hard_boundary: Never infer consumed model input from declared packet metadata, source path presence, loader activity or prompt construction alone. Bind what the model runtime actually consumed at the claimed scope.

next_exact_action: Advance the Qwen3.5 candidate/input chain from loader-activity-only to selection-grade consumed identity: bind exact checkpoint manifest/tokenizer/template/runtime identity and exact model-visible rendered input bytes/tokens to the model call/output receipt. Keep checkpoint winner null until matched evaluation and consumed identity both close. Do not add training rows or provider execution.
